item.title: Neville Wisdom Dies, Power Outage, Michelle Williams
item.ns0:title: Neville Wisdom Dies, Power Outage, Michelle Williams
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, the nation mourns the passing of former Cabinet Minister and beloved public servant Neville Wisdom as tributes pour in from across the political spectrum. We also bring you key explanations from Bahamas Power and Light leadership regarding the widespread power outages that recently plunged parts of New Providence into darkness. Plus, we look at newly released calls from regional observers for major election reforms, explore vital disaster preparedness initiatives years after Hurricane Dorian, and sit down for an exclusive chat with Grammy-winning superstar Michelle Williams ahead of her highly anticipated local performances. Tune in to catch up on these stories, your weekend sports roundup, and a full weather update.
